strings.footer.tagline: Generated straight from the game build
strings.home.title: Pixel Chronicles Wiki
strings.home.subtitle: Every item, monster, drop chance and recipe, read straight out of the game project.
strings.sort.name: Name
strings.items.title: Items
strings.items.subtitle: {n} items — stats, rarity, where they drop and how they are crafted.
strings.item.noDrops: Not in any loot table — obtained by crafting, the shop, or stage rewards.
strings.monsters.title: Monsters
strings.monsters.subtitle: {n} monsters, {summonable} of them summonable — several appear in no combat level and can only be summoned. Base stats are the level-1 values on the entity prefab, before the per-level multipliers a stage applies.
strings.monster.noSummon: In no summon pool — not currently obtainable.
strings.monster.summonedFrom: Summoned from the {pools} pool. Check the in-game banner for current rates.
strings.monster.noLootTable: No personal loot table. Bosses drop through their stage's reward pool instead.
strings.loot.title: Loot tables
strings.loot.subtitle: {n} tables. Chances are per kill or per harvest, listed for each difficulty.
strings.loot.empty: No loot table matches these filters.
strings.recipes.title: Recipes
strings.recipes.subtitle: {n} recipes.
strings.sets.title: Item sets
strings.sets.subtitle: {n} sets. Wearing every piece grants the listed bonus.
strings.buildings.title: Buildings
strings.buildings.subtitle: {n} buildings you can buy. The ones that start as ruins on your island and are repaired rather than purchased are left out.
strings.status.title: Status effects
strings.status.subtitle: {n} effects — {buffs} buffs and {debuffs} debuffs. Values are the ones the game's own tooltips show.
strings.talents.title: Talents
strings.talents.subtitle: {n} talents. Every rank replaces the one before it — the values are not cumulative.
strings.modes.title: Game modes
strings.modes.subtitle: Only released content is listed. Locations whose waves are still empty in the build are left out and will appear here on their own once they are filled in.
strings.mode.wavesOrder: Waves are listed in the order they spawn.
strings.mode.accessoryNote: Clearing this tier rolls one accessory: a tier, then a rarity, drawn independently.
strings.error.staleCache: Your browser may be holding an older version of the wiki. Reload with {shortcut}.
strings.error.reportBug: If it keeps happening, this is a bug worth reporting:
strings.error.loadFailed: Could not load the wiki data.
strings.bastion.subtitle: Three players defend the Nexus at the centre of the map against endless waves. There is no authored wave list: every wave is generated from the formulas below.
strings.bastion.scalingNote: Computed with the game's own formulas at {players} players. Budget buys enemies from the pool; the multipliers apply to every enemy that wave.
strings.bastion.assailantNote: Assailants rush the Nexus instead of fighting. They carry {n}× the wave's HP.
strings.bastion.bossNote: Boss waves add one boss with {stats}× stats and {health}× HP. One boss of the wave's element is drawn, without repeats until the rotation runs out.
strings.bastion.poolNote: One pool is drawn per wave, then the budget is spent on enemies from it. An enemy only becomes available once the wave reaches its minimum.
strings.bastion.upgradesNote: {n} upgrades. Each pick either unlocks one or raises it a level, and a level replaces the one before it.
strings.talents.oddsNote: Rolling a talent draws one of the {n} talents at random — {pct}% each — and then its rank, with the odds below.
strings.tree.title: Skill tree
strings.tree.subtitle: {n} nodes across {classes} classes. Your character spends skill points here; the branch you commit to is your class.
strings.tree.empty: The skill tree is not in this build yet.
strings.tree.mapNote: The tree at its real layout. Hover a node for its name, click it to jump to its entry below.
strings.tree.rulePrereq: A node with several parents needs them all, both to unlock and to activate.
strings.tree.ruleOffClass: Activating a node outside your main class costs {n}× the skill points.
strings.tree.ruleClasses: Your first class is free; each extra class costs {n} diamonds.
